results.label: lem:finite-decomposition
results.title: Gram-invariant decomposition
results.statement: For the special direct-sum features, the finite test decomposes as G_m = L_m - R_m, with R_m obtained by realigning the paper minus pure block.
results.scope: The frozen kernel identity cancellation proves M + (P_plus+P_minus)/2 + realign(P_plus) = B + D + realign(D+K). In its convention M = B - realign(T). Reversing the positive pure wedge gives K_paper = -K_Lean and P_minus,paper = P_plus,Lean; the paper mixed correction +calR(E1) corresponds to the frozen -realign(T) with E1_paper = -T_Lean. Thus both identities cancel the same repairs, but no declaration states the arXiv matrix L_m/R_m decomposition for every special V.
